name: New Valley
source:
New Valley is a choice-based visual novel, in which you take on the role of "Merlin", a widow and her daughter, "Sara". They recently moved to New Valley, a mysterious village. Merlin was extremely affected by loneliness, despite of all her feelings she survive, but something is haunting them.......

[Edited from [url=https://epicwolfstudio.itch.io/new-valley]Itch.io[/url]]
